kind: simulation: real page script, stub chrome object, real input events in Chrome for Testing

checks.name: Plain Command-click on a link passes through to the page untouched
A Command-press that moves 5 px stays a click and starts no selection
A drag without the modifier does nothing
Command-drag of 6 px or more starts selection; the ending click is suppressed once
Only one click is suppressed; the next click reaches the page
Command-drag that starts on a link selects instead of dragging the link
A Command-drag that starts in a text field starts no selection
content.configure switches off, then to the letter Q, without a reload
Unticking a link in the preview leaves it out of every action
Shortcuts U and K copy URLs and Markdown while focus is in the card
Typing in the page does not trigger card shortcuts
The More menu lists seven actions, moves with the arrow keys and closes on Escape
The destination picker sends collectionId and the receipt names that collection
Review after saving opens the full view at that capture (ui.open with view and batchId)
Open 3 in tabs opens at once, with no confirmation
Download this selection saves the file name the background chose
Bookmark without access explains it and offers the full view at the export panel
45 links: the card confirms (Open 45, New window, Cancel) before opening
150 links: stronger wording; Escape cancels only the confirmation
520 links: refused before anything is sent
The card shows progress and cancels its own opening
Content links only: header, nav (with its shadow root), role=navigation, aside (with its same-origin frame), contentinfo and footer links start unticked, and the card says how many
Already saved: capture.saved is asked for the destination when the card opens and when it changes; matching rows say Saved
Include them ticks the 10 navigation links again; Always include them saves only contentOnly: false (capture.preference)
Filters All, Other sites, PDFs and Same site untick what doesn’t match; All ticks those again; keyboard and aria-pressed work
Skip saved starts from the setting; Make this the default saves only skipSaved (capture.preference)
Copy as rich links (More menu and L) puts HTML and plain text on the clipboard, also through the copy-event fallback
Skip saved: capture.commit gets skipSaved, and the receipt says “Added 14 links …; 2 were already saved”
After a drag, copy: copies the content links as a table at once; the notice is themed like the card (Ember light), and Show links opens the card with the same links
After a drag, copy in every format (URLs, Markdown, rich links); the close button and Escape close the notice
The notice closes itself after about 8 seconds, stays while it has focus, and a new drag replaces it
After a drag, add: commits at once with skipSaved; the notice has Undo (capture.undoAdd) and Show links; after Undo the card can add again
Undo also works from the card after Show links; a refused Undo says why in the notice
Content links only keeps a post’s own header and footer links: only page-level headers and footers are page chrome
On Windows and Linux the modifier is Ctrl, not Command
